task.ques: Discover a suitable chocolate cupcake recipe on Allrecipes that has a preparation time of under 1 hour and at least 100 user reviews.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Easy Moist Chocolate Cupcakes on Allrecipes meets the requirements: 15 minutes preparation time (30 minutes total) and 958 user reviews, exceeding the minimum of 100. Verified October 27, 2026.
Source: https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/17377/chocolate-cupcakes/
Evidence: final.png shows the recipe name, review count, preparation time and total time together.
